mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.task_id,c.token_digest,c.root_invocation_id,c.page_index,c.query_digest,c.expires_at,r.body,r.body_digest,r.binding_digest,r.state FROM mcp_cursor c JOIN mcp_result r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.task_id=c.task_id AND r.root_invocation_id=c.root_invocation_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.task_id=#{task} AND c.token_digest=#{token} AND c.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND r.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_cursor(tenant_id,task_id,token_digest,root_invocation_id,page_index,query_digest,expires_at) SELECT tenant_id,task_id,#{token},root_invocation_id,#{page},#{queryDigest},expires_at FROM mcp_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation_id=#{invocation}
